name: lightsail
description: Amazon Lightsail is the easiest way to get started with Amazon Web Services (Amazon Web Services) for developers who need to build websites or web applications.

subcommands.name: allocate-static-ip
subcommands.description: Allocates a static IP address.

subcommands.name: attach-certificate-to-distribution
subcommands.description: Attaches an SSL/TLS certificate to your Amazon Lightsail content delivery network (CDN) distribution.

subcommands.name: attach-disk
subcommands.description: Attaches a block storage disk to a running or stopped Lightsail instance and exposes it to the instance with the specified disk name.

subcommands.name: attach-instances-to-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Attaches one or more Lightsail instances to a load balancer.

subcommands.name: attach-load-balancer-tls-certificate
subcommands.description: Attaches a Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificate to your load balancer.

subcommands.name: attach-static-ip
subcommands.description: Attaches a static IP address to a specific Amazon Lightsail instance.

subcommands.name: close-instance-public-ports
subcommands.description: Closes ports for a specific Amazon Lightsail instance.

subcommands.name: copy-snapshot
subcommands.description: Copies a manual snapshot of an instance or disk as another manual snapshot, or copies an automatic snapshot of an instance or disk as a manual snapshot.

subcommands.name: create-bucket
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Lightsail bucket.

subcommands.name: create-bucket-access-key
subcommands.description: Creates a new access key for the specified Amazon Lightsail bucket.

subcommands.name: create-certificate
subcommands.description: Creates an SSL/TLS certificate for an Amazon Lightsail content delivery network (CDN) distribution and a container service.

subcommands.name: create-cloud-formation-stack
subcommands.description: Creates an AWS CloudFormation stack, which creates a new Amazon EC2 instance from an exported Amazon Lightsail snapshot.

subcommands.name: create-contact-method
subcommands.description: Creates an email or SMS text message contact method.

subcommands.name: create-container-service
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Lightsail container service.

subcommands.name: create-container-service-deployment
subcommands.description: Creates a deployment for your Amazon Lightsail container service.

subcommands.name: create-container-service-registry-login
subcommands.description: Creates a temporary set of log in credentials that you can use to log in to the Docker process on your local machine.

subcommands.name: create-disk
subcommands.description: Creates a block storage disk that can be attached to an Amazon Lightsail instance in the same Availability Zone (us-east-2a).

subcommands.name: create-disk-from-snapshot
subcommands.description: Creates a block storage disk from a manual or automatic snapshot of a disk.

subcommands.name: create-disk-snapshot
subcommands.description: Creates a snapshot of a block storage disk.

subcommands.name: create-distribution
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Lightsail content delivery network (CDN) distribution.

subcommands.name: create-domain
subcommands.description: Creates a domain resource for the specified domain (example.com).

subcommands.name: create-domain-entry
subcommands.description: Creates one of the following domain name system (DNS) records in a domain DNS zone: Address (A), canonical name (CNAME), mail exchanger (MX), name server (NS), start of authority (SOA), service locator (SRV), or text (TXT).

subcommands.name: create-gui-session-access-details
subcommands.description: Creates two URLs that are used to access a virtual computer’s graphical user interface (GUI) session.

subcommands.name: create-instance-snapshot
subcommands.description: Creates a snapshot of a specific virtual private server, or instance.

subcommands.name: create-instances
subcommands.description: Creates one or more Amazon Lightsail instances.

subcommands.name: create-instances-from-snapshot
subcommands.description: Creates one or more new instances from a manual or automatic snapshot of an instance.

subcommands.name: create-key-pair
subcommands.description: Creates a custom SSH key pair that you can use with an Amazon Lightsail instance.

subcommands.name: create-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Creates a Lightsail load balancer.

subcommands.name: create-load-balancer-tls-certificate
subcommands.description: Creates an SSL/TLS certificate for an Amazon Lightsail load balancer.

subcommands.name: create-relational-database
subcommands.description: Creates a new database in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: create-relational-database-from-snapshot
subcommands.description: Creates a new database from an existing database snapshot in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: create-relational-database-snapshot
subcommands.description: Creates a snapshot of your database in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: delete-alarm
subcommands.description: Deletes an alarm.

subcommands.name: delete-auto-snapshot
subcommands.description: Deletes an automatic snapshot of an instance or disk.

subcommands.name: delete-bucket
subcommands.description: Deletes a Amazon Lightsail bucket.

subcommands.name: delete-bucket-access-key
subcommands.description: Deletes an access key for the specified Amazon Lightsail bucket.

subcommands.name: delete-certificate
subcommands.description: Deletes an SSL/TLS certificate for your Amazon Lightsail content delivery network (CDN) distribution.

subcommands.name: delete-contact-method
subcommands.description: Deletes a contact method.

subcommands.name: delete-container-image
subcommands.description: Deletes a container image that is registered to your Amazon Lightsail container service.

subcommands.name: delete-container-service
subcommands.description: Deletes your Amazon Lightsail container service.

subcommands.name: delete-disk
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified block storage disk.

subcommands.name: delete-disk-snapshot
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified disk snapshot.

subcommands.name: delete-distribution
subcommands.description: Deletes your Amazon Lightsail content delivery network (CDN) distribution.

subcommands.name: delete-domain
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified domain recordset and all of its domain records.

subcommands.name: delete-domain-entry
subcommands.description: Deletes a specific domain entry.

subcommands.name: delete-instance
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Lightsail instance.

subcommands.name: delete-instance-snapshot
subcommands.description: Deletes a specific snapshot of a virtual private server (or instance).

subcommands.name: delete-key-pair
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified key pair by removing the public key from Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: delete-known-host-keys
subcommands.description: Deletes the known host key or certificate used by the Amazon Lightsail browser-based SSH or RDP clients to authenticate an instance.

subcommands.name: delete-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Deletes a Lightsail load balancer and all its associated SSL/TLS certificates.

subcommands.name: delete-load-balancer-tls-certificate
subcommands.description: Deletes an SSL/TLS certificate associated with a Lightsail load balancer.

subcommands.name: delete-relational-database
subcommands.description: Deletes a database in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: delete-relational-database-snapshot
subcommands.description: Deletes a database snapshot in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: detach-certificate-from-distribution
subcommands.description: Detaches an SSL/TLS certificate from your Amazon Lightsail content delivery network (CDN) distribution.

subcommands.name: detach-disk
subcommands.description: Detaches a stopped block storage disk from a Lightsail instance.

subcommands.name: detach-instances-from-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Detaches the specified instances from a Lightsail load balancer.

subcommands.name: detach-static-ip
subcommands.description: Detaches a static IP from the Amazon Lightsail instance to which it is attached.

subcommands.name: disable-add-on
subcommands.description: Disables an add-on for an Amazon Lightsail resource.

subcommands.name: download-default-key-pair
subcommands.description: Downloads the regional Amazon Lightsail default key pair.

subcommands.name: enable-add-on
subcommands.description: Enables or modifies an add-on for an Amazon Lightsail resource.

subcommands.name: export-snapshot
subcommands.description: Exports an Amazon Lightsail instance or block storage disk snapshot to Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2).

subcommands.name: get-active-names
subcommands.description: Returns the names of all active (not deleted) resources.

subcommands.name: get-alarms
subcommands.description: Returns information about the configured alarms.

subcommands.name: get-auto-snapshots
subcommands.description: Returns the available automatic snapshots for an instance or disk.

subcommands.name: get-blueprints
subcommands.description: Returns the list of available instance images, or blueprints.

subcommands.name: get-bucket-access-keys
subcommands.description: Returns the existing access key IDs for the specified Amazon Lightsail bucket.

subcommands.name: get-bucket-bundles
subcommands.description: Returns the bundles that you can apply to a Amazon Lightsail bucket.

subcommands.name: get-bucket-metric-data
subcommands.description: Returns the data points of a specific metric for an Amazon Lightsail bucket.

subcommands.name: get-buckets
subcommands.description: Returns information about one or more Amazon Lightsail buckets.

subcommands.name: get-bundles
subcommands.description: Returns the bundles that you can apply to an Amazon Lightsail instance when you create it.

subcommands.name: get-certificates
subcommands.description: Returns information about one or more Amazon Lightsail SSL/TLS certificates.

subcommands.name: get-cloud-formation-stack-records
subcommands.description: Returns the CloudFormation stack record created as a result of the create cloud formation stack operation.

subcommands.name: get-contact-methods
subcommands.description: Returns information about the configured contact methods.

subcommands.name: get-container-api-metadata
subcommands.description: Returns information about Amazon Lightsail containers, such as the current version of the Lightsail Control (lightsailctl) plugin.

subcommands.name: get-container-images
subcommands.description: Returns the container images that are registered to your Amazon Lightsail container service.

subcommands.name: get-container-log
subcommands.description: Returns the log events of a container of your Amazon Lightsail container service.

subcommands.name: get-container-service-deployments
subcommands.description: Returns the deployments for your Amazon Lightsail container service A deployment specifies the settings, such as the ports and launch command, of containers that are deployed to your container service.

subcommands.name: get-container-service-metric-data
subcommands.description: Returns the data points of a specific metric of your Amazon Lightsail container service.

subcommands.name: get-container-service-powers
subcommands.description: Returns the list of powers that can be specified for your Amazon Lightsail container services.

subcommands.name: get-container-services
subcommands.description: Returns information about one or more of your Amazon Lightsail container services.

subcommands.name: get-cost-estimate
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the cost estimate for a specified resource.

subcommands.name: get-disk
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific block storage disk.

subcommands.name: get-disk-snapshot
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific block storage disk snapshot.

subcommands.name: get-disk-snapshots
subcommands.description: Returns information about all block storage disk snapshots in your AWS account and region.

subcommands.name: get-disks
subcommands.description: Returns information about all block storage disks in your AWS account and region.

subcommands.name: get-distribution-bundles
subcommands.description: Returns the bundles that can be applied to your Amazon Lightsail content delivery network (CDN) distributions.

subcommands.name: get-distribution-latest-cache-reset
subcommands.description: Returns the timestamp and status of the last cache reset of a specific Amazon Lightsail content delivery network (CDN) distribution.

subcommands.name: get-distribution-metric-data
subcommands.description: Returns the data points of a specific metric for an Amazon Lightsail content delivery network (CDN) distribution.

subcommands.name: get-distributions
subcommands.description: Returns information about one or more of your Amazon Lightsail content delivery network (CDN) distributions.

subcommands.name: get-domain
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific domain recordset.

subcommands.name: get-domains
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all domains in the user's account.

subcommands.name: get-export-snapshot-records
subcommands.description: Returns all export snapshot records created as a result of the export snapshot operation.

subcommands.name: get-instance
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific Amazon Lightsail instance, which is a virtual private server.

subcommands.name: get-instance-access-details
subcommands.description: Returns temporary SSH keys you can use to connect to a specific virtual private server, or instance.

subcommands.name: get-instance-metric-data
subcommands.description: Returns the data points for the specified Amazon Lightsail instance metric, given an instance name.

subcommands.name: get-instance-port-states
subcommands.description: Returns the firewall port states for a specific Amazon Lightsail instance, the IP addresses allowed to connect to the instance through the ports, and the protocol.

subcommands.name: get-instance-snapshot
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific instance snapshot.

subcommands.name: get-instance-snapshots
subcommands.description: Returns all instance snapshots for the user's account.

subcommands.name: get-instance-state
subcommands.description: Returns the state of a specific instance.

subcommands.name: get-instances
subcommands.description: Returns information about all Amazon Lightsail virtual private servers, or instances.

subcommands.name: get-key-pair
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific key pair.

subcommands.name: get-key-pairs
subcommands.description: Returns information about all key pairs in the user's account.

subcommands.name: get-load-balancer
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified Lightsail load balancer.

subcommands.name: get-load-balancer-metric-data
subcommands.description: Returns information about health metrics for your Lightsail load balancer.

subcommands.name: get-load-balancer-tls-certificates
subcommands.description: Returns information about the TLS certificates that are associated with the specified Lightsail load balancer.

subcommands.name: get-load-balancer-tls-policies
subcommands.description: Returns a list of TLS security policies that you can apply to Lightsail load balancers.

subcommands.name: get-load-balancers
subcommands.description: Returns information about all load balancers in an account.

subcommands.name: get-operation
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific operation.

subcommands.name: get-operations
subcommands.description: Returns information about all operations.

subcommands.name: get-operations-for-resource
subcommands.description: Gets operations for a specific resource (an instance or a static IP).

subcommands.name: get-regions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of all valid regions for Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: get-relational-database
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific database in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: get-relational-database-blueprints
subcommands.description: Returns a list of available database blueprints in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: get-relational-database-bundles
subcommands.description: Returns the list of bundles that are available in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: get-relational-database-events
subcommands.description: Returns a list of events for a specific database in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: get-relational-database-log-events
subcommands.description: Returns a list of log events for a database in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: get-relational-database-log-streams
subcommands.description: Returns a list of available log streams for a specific database in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: get-relational-database-master-user-password
subcommands.description: Returns the current, previous, or pending versions of the master user password for a Lightsail database.

subcommands.name: get-relational-database-metric-data
subcommands.description: Returns the data points of the specified metric for a database in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: get-relational-database-parameters
subcommands.description: Returns all of the runtime parameters offered by the underlying database software, or engine, for a specific database in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: get-relational-database-snapshot
subcommands.description: Returns information about a specific database snapshot in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: get-relational-database-snapshots
subcommands.description: Returns information about all of your database snapshots in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: get-relational-databases
subcommands.description: Returns information about all of your databases in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: get-setup-history
subcommands.description: Returns detailed information for five of the most recent SetupInstanceHttps requests that were ran on the target instance.

subcommands.name: get-static-ip
subcommands.description: Returns information about an Amazon Lightsail static IP.

subcommands.name: get-static-ips
subcommands.description: Returns information about all static IPs in the user's account.

subcommands.name: import-key-pair
subcommands.description: Imports a public SSH key from a specific key pair.

subcommands.name: is-vpc-peered
subcommands.description: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether your Lightsail VPC is peered.

subcommands.name: open-instance-public-ports
subcommands.description: Opens ports for a specific Amazon Lightsail instance, and specifies the IP addresses allowed to connect to the instance through the ports, and the protocol.

subcommands.name: peer-vpc
subcommands.description: Peers the Lightsail VPC with the user's default VPC.

subcommands.name: put-alarm
subcommands.description: Creates or updates an alarm, and associates it with the specified metric.

subcommands.name: put-instance-public-ports
subcommands.description: Opens ports for a specific Amazon Lightsail instance, and specifies the IP addresses allowed to connect to the instance through the ports, and the protocol.

subcommands.name: reboot-instance
subcommands.description: Restarts a specific instance.

subcommands.name: reboot-relational-database
subcommands.description: Restarts a specific database in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: register-container-image
subcommands.description: Registers a container image to your Amazon Lightsail container service.

subcommands.name: release-static-ip
subcommands.description: Deletes a specific static IP from your account.

subcommands.name: reset-distribution-cache
subcommands.description: Deletes currently cached content from your Amazon Lightsail content delivery network (CDN) distribution.

subcommands.name: send-contact-method-verification
subcommands.description: Sends a verification request to an email contact method to ensure it's owned by the requester.

subcommands.name: set-ip-address-type
subcommands.description: Sets the IP address type for an Amazon Lightsail resource.

subcommands.name: set-resource-access-for-bucket
subcommands.description: Sets the Amazon Lightsail resources that can access the specified Lightsail bucket.

subcommands.name: setup-instance-https
subcommands.description: Creates an SSL/TLS certificate that secures traffic for your website.

subcommands.name: start-gui-session
subcommands.description: Initiates a graphical user interface (GUI) session that’s used to access a virtual computer’s operating system and application.

subcommands.name: start-instance
subcommands.description: Starts a specific Amazon Lightsail instance from a stopped state.

subcommands.name: start-relational-database
subcommands.description: Starts a specific database from a stopped state in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: stop-gui-session
subcommands.description: Terminates a web-based Amazon DCV session that’s used to access a virtual computer’s operating system or application.

subcommands.name: stop-instance
subcommands.description: Stops a specific Amazon Lightsail instance that is currently running.

subcommands.name: stop-relational-database
subcommands.description: Stops a specific database that is currently running in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to the specified Amazon Lightsail resource.

subcommands.name: test-alarm
subcommands.description: Tests an alarm by displaying a banner on the Amazon Lightsail console.

subcommands.name: unpeer-vpc
subcommands.description: Unpeers the Lightsail VPC from the user's default VPC.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified set of tag keys and their values from the specified Amazon Lightsail resource.

subcommands.name: update-bucket
subcommands.description: Updates an existing Amazon Lightsail bucket.

subcommands.name: update-bucket-bundle
subcommands.description: Updates the bundle, or storage plan, of an existing Amazon Lightsail bucket.

subcommands.name: update-container-service
subcommands.description: Updates the configuration of your Amazon Lightsail container service, such as its power, scale, and public domain names.

subcommands.name: update-distribution
subcommands.description: Updates an existing Amazon Lightsail content delivery network (CDN) distribution.

subcommands.name: update-distribution-bundle
subcommands.description: Updates the bundle of your Amazon Lightsail content delivery network (CDN) distribution.

subcommands.name: update-domain-entry
subcommands.description: Updates a domain recordset after it is created.

subcommands.name: update-instance-metadata-options
subcommands.description: Modifies the Amazon Lightsail instance metadata parameters on a running or stopped instance.

subcommands.name: update-load-balancer-attribute
subcommands.description: Updates the specified attribute for a load balancer.

subcommands.name: update-relational-database
subcommands.description: Allows the update of one or more attributes of a database in Amazon Lightsail.

subcommands.name: update-relational-database-parameters
subcommands.description: Allows the update of one or more parameters of a database in Amazon Lightsail.
